hardware_software: Ryzen AI 7 H 350 / AIE2P / XRT 2.25.00 / firmware 1.0.0.63 / Linux 7.0.0-38-generic / locked project compiler
experiment: Convert ReLU outputs to BF16 on the existing four key workers; multicast BF16 to value workers. Combine raw and FP32 activated diagnostics into one FIFO per core and scatter back into the original host ABI. Explicit placement and memory-tile input fanout. No extra converter core or submission.
compile_constraints: Automatic placement rejected compute-peer DMA budget
Three producer streams require three output DMA channels; hardware supports two, so combined FP32 diagnostic streams
Diagnostic scatter innermost extent 2048 and 1024 rejected by DMA lowering; [4,2,4,512] sizes / [2048,8192,512,1] strides compiled and passed oracle/guards

validation.channel_mix: Independent FP64 oracle, replay, immutable input and guards passed; max_abs=2.42144e-7
validation.reference: 128-token pre-change snapshot from preceding cache experiment; SHA-256 verified before use

decision: Reverted: stage means unchanged and whole-model difference below process variation. Production artifacts were never replaced. Avoid retaining extra layout complexity without demonstrated improvement.
limitations: No hardware saturation claim; host waits contain DMA and program-switching costs
INT8 path not changed or promoted
Numerical regression covers 128 tokens, not full-context language quality
next_work: Implement batched BF16 projection with weight-tile reuse across tokens as a building block for real NPU prefill. Sequential full-model prefill remains a major unfinished requirement.
